operational_failure_classification.02-calls-vs-agents: Anthropic account credit exhausted; trace-confirmed HTTP 400

conclusion: Eleven of thirteen planned cases delivered task-fulfilling answers on this reused development suite. Init is useful but incomplete against the unchanged authentication/agent-export assertion. Case 02 delivered no substantive answer because Anthropic rejected the final planner call for insufficient account credit; its semantic quality is unassessed, not wrong. The judge was then withheld, leaving three ungraded assertions. No material unsupported product claim was found in the twelve substantive answers. Provider failure remains in the planned denominator. This does not establish general reliability or a reliable completeness checker.
